description: This file defines the SystemCheckController class within the OrangeHRM installer module. The class extends an abstract installer Vue controller and sets up the 'system check' screen component for the installation process, including defining a preRender method that initializes the component with specific properties and updates the application state.

classes.name: SystemCheckController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling the system check step in the installer process, initializing the Vue component for system checks and updating application state.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the system check component for rendering, setting its properties and updating the current screen state.
